facts.text: I am a 23-year-old woman with fever, chills, nausea, and urinary urgency and frequency.

My temperature is 39.0°C (102.2°F).
My blood pressure is 100/70 mm Hg.

My urine nitrites are positive.
My urine leukocyte esterase is positive.
My urine bilirubin is negative.

My urine protein is trace.
My urine blood is none.
My urine WBC count is 25/hpf.
My urine bacteria count is many.
